name: Ducol Organics & Colours Ltd.
summary: Ducol Organics & Colours Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing and supply of pigment dispersions, preparations, concentrates, emulsions, pastes, colorants, masterbatches, and tinters. The company operates within the dyes and pigments industry, providing specialized colorant solutions. It serves a diverse range of industrial sectors, including paints, inks, plastics, textiles, detergents, rubber, cement, and paper. Operating on a business-to-business model, Ducol Organics & Colours Ltd. focuses on offering customized and value-added pigment preparations. The company has a pan-India customer base and also exports its products to various countries across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.
